text:
maria_sales: FYI, Acme legal came back with a mixed SIG/Privacy ask — they want a DPA + SCCs, plus confirmation we can delete user data on request within 30 days. Can we confirm?

kai_se: I can map SIG control IDs to our DPA clauses. Quick Q: are they running the POC on Hosted or Dedicated?

maria_sales: Hosted for the POC, may move to Dedicated if perf checks pass. They're also asking for committed capacity pricing for a 3-month pilot. @tony_sec any pricing caveats?

tony_sec: Pricing note: Dedicated pricing requires a 1-month minimum commit; for a 3-month pilot we can do a short-term reserved quote. Security-wise: Hosted -> our data residency zones apply. We persist KV cache 24h by default; we can set cache.ttl=0 for the POC to minimize retention. DSAR/deletion: we have a deletion API that marks and purges records; primary retention purge within 30d, backups up to 90d (disaster recovery). Need legal to sign off on SCC wording for that.

jess_legal: Confirm we can sign the standard EU SCCs + our DPA addendum. For backups, propose adding: "backups may be retained up to 90 days for disaster recovery; any restored data will be subject to data subject requests and deletion obligations." I'll draft the clause and share.

maria_sales: Timeline: customer wants SIG-lite + CAIQ answers by EOD Friday. Is that doable?

kai_se: I can finish SIG mapping by tomorrow morning and fill the CAIQ matrix. Will call out controls we own vs controls needing infra/legal (e.g., physical access, third-party audits). I'll include short explanatory notes.

tony_sec: Encryption: all customer data at rest is AES-256. KMS integrations supported (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys. Network isolation: VPC peering + private subnets for Dedicated. Note: Private deployment has different operational checklist.

jess_legal: One more privacy point — processing purpose language. Customer asked to remove "improve the service" phrase. Recommend we keep but offer opt-out via contract ("we may use aggregated, de-identified data to improve services"). I'll add both options to the draft.

maria_sales: Great. @ops-bot please create a POC checklist and add items: "SCCs signed", "cache.ttl set to 0 for POC", "deletion API runbook handed off", "committed pricing quote (3mo)". Also add owner for SIG answers.

ops-bot: Created task POC-ACME-2025 and checklist: https://internal/tasks/POC-ACME-2025 (owner: kai_se) :white_check_mark:

kai_se: Dropping the SIG snippet here, will upload full CAIQ spreadsheet after lunch. Snippet: 
```
cache:
  ttl_seconds: 0
  persist_kv: false
```

maria_sales: Perfect — once Jess posts the DPA redline I'll send to the customer with the SIG draft. Thanks team :thumbsup:
